defects.justification: GET /orders/{orderId} has no authentication at all (handleOrder goes straight to store.findOrder at line 131), so anyone who can reach the service can read any order's payment status and paid/refunded amounts by guessing or enumerating order ids.
The JDK HttpServer is used with a fixed pool of 8 threads and no read or idle timeout; eight slow clients that dribble their bodies (readNBytes blocks) occupy every worker and stall webhook delivery.
